### CDW to Participate in the Citi 2026 Global TMT Conference


August 25, 2026


VERNON HILLS, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


CDW Corporation (Nasdaq: CDW) today announced that Christine A. Leahy, chair and chief executive officer, and Albert J. Miralles, chief financial officer and executive vice president, enterprise business operations, CDW, will participate in a question and answer session at the Citi Global TMT Conference to be held in New York City on Tuesday, September 8, 2026, at 9:50am CT / 10:50am ET. The presentation will be webcast live on[investor.CDW.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.cdw.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54594019&newsitemid=20260825392434&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.CDW.com&index=1&md5=b2c8d8dfa10716af6ef5f40e3c50b46c) . An archived copy of the webcast will be available on the same website for one year following the completion of the event.


**About CDW**


CDW Corporation is a leading multi-brand provider of information technology solutions to business, government, education and healthcare customers in the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada. CDW helps its customers to navigate an increasingly complex IT market and maximize return on their technology investments. For additional information, please visit[www.CDW.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cdw.com%2F&esheet=54594019&newsitemid=20260825392434&lan=en-US&anchor=www.CDW.com&index=2&md5=1bd693999abf65fee11eb4fb69820b05) .
